title: Compatibility remainder of the field purity transpose
statement: For fixed projection comparisons and coordinates satisfying the base tensor and finite-level clauses, the three finite-Tor pair-domain hypotheses imply the tensor compatibility and diagonal purity compatibility clauses of lem-sp-field-purity-system-transpose.

source.place: (2), tensor-map transpose; returned step 7 second and final paragraphs

proof.text: Use the inverted projection-system square on the three pair-domain hypotheses and the counit equation at the coefficient unit. Compare the two resulting maps by injectivity of the tower adjunction Hom bijection. Precompose with the diagonal orientations and use the tower-gamma scalar comparison to obtain diagonal purity compatibility as a whole-system equality.

split_report.summary: Proved coefficient compatibility in the ordinary derived category of whole systems by inverting the existing projection square and comparing counit transposes. Checked unit normalization and assembled diagonal orientations; reused every needed lemma, creating no nodes.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes det-sp-field-extension-towers proof (2), tensor-map transpose and purity compatibility, before inverse limit.

tool_uses.why: Generic open-adjunction characterization on arbitrary ringed diagram topoi proves tensor-unit normalization; it does not replace any step of the field-extension route.
